description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB2_mysql' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' to handle MySQL-specific database schema operations, including type mapping, index management, and SQL generation for schema modifications.

classes.name: ADODB2_mysql
classes.description: A class providing MySQL-specific database schema manipulation methods, including type mapping, index management, and SQL statement generation.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps PHP data types and field properties to MySQL-specific type codes.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts internal type codes back to MySQL data types.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffix for column definitions based on attributes like unsigned, not null, default, auto-increment, and constraints.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for creating, dropping, or replacing indexes on tables.
